Are you someone who enjoys going to the gym during the day or prefers doing your grocery shopping when it's nice and quiet? Then a career as a Line Operator could be exactly what you're looking for!

Working in shifts gives you a flexible schedule, making it feel like you have an extra day off every week. Sounds good, right?

As a line operator, you are responsible for ensuring the production process runs smoothly in a modern manufacturing environment. You will set up, operate, and monitor production machines and equipment to ensure production is carried out safely, efficiently, and in line with quality standards.

You will keep a close eye on the production process, identify any irregularities, and take action when needed. You'll also troubleshoot minor machine issues independently and perform first-line maintenance to keep operations running smoothly. In addition, you will carry out quality inspections and accurately record production data.

In this role, you'll work closely with colleagues from production, logistics, and the technical department. Maintaining high standards of hygiene, safety, and quality is an essential part of the job and the working environment.

- Accurate and quality-conscious
- Results-driven, flexible, and proactive
- A team player
- Good command of Dutch or English

Go to work as an order picker at Arvato in Venlo and make sure that thousands of orders are shipped on time every day. You will work in a modern distribution center, earn €14.99 gross per hour, receive travel allowance, build up pension through Manpower, and have the opportunity to receive a contract with Arvato upon good performance. Read on quickly!

Your tasks at Arvato include:

    - Collecting products based on digital instructions
    
- Scanning items with a handheld scanner
    
- Processing and sorting goods in the warehouse
    
- Packing orders according to the applicable guidelines
    
- Applying shipping labels and transport documents
    
- Preparing shipments for transport

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower
    
- Opportunity for a contract with Arvato upon good performance
    
- Travel allowance according to Arvato’s regulations
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Part-time or full-time position of 32 to 40 hours per week
    
- Additional allowances for shift work, overtime and changed working hours
    
- Working in a modern and automated distribution center

    - In possession of a valid Dutch work permit
    
- Basic knowledge of the English language to understand work instructions and communicate with colleagues
    
- Good numerical skills and an accurate way of working
    
- Good physical condition and no physical limitations that prevent you from performing the work
    
- Experience with a handheld scanner is a plus
    
- Available for at least 32 hours per week

Would you like to start working as an order picker at Arvato in Venlo? Don’t wait too long and apply today via Manpower. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible to discuss the next steps.

Start as a warehouse worker at Arvato in Venlo and work together with your colleagues to ensure orders are processed quickly and accurately. You will work in a modern distribution centre where teamwork and quality are key. In return, you will receive a gross hourly wage of €14.99, travel reimbursement, pension accrual through Manpower, and the opportunity to receive a contract with Arvato if you perform well. Read on!

As a warehouse employee, you will have a varied role. Your tasks include:

    - Processing incoming and outgoing goods
    
- Picking orders using a handheld scanner
    
- Checking and sorting products
    
- Packing orders according to the correct procedures
    
- Applying shipping labels and preparing parcels for dispatch

What’s in it for you

- Basic command of the English language to understand work instructions and communicate with colleagues
    
- Good numerical skills and an accurate working attitude
    
- Good physical condition with no physical complaints that could affect your work
    
- Availability of at least 32 hours per week

Data Analyst - Factory & Production Engineering 
 Veldhoven 
 Do you get energized by supporting a complex manufacturing process and driving structural improvements through data? In this role you will directly support the Production Engineering teams of a high-tech manufacturing organisation. By navigating a large-scale data migration and building advanced visualisation tools, you make sure the engineering organisation has the exact insights needed to optimise quality, cycle time and efficiency on the shopfloor. 
 Organisatie & Afdeling 
You will join a multidisciplinary engineering department with English as the working language. Day to day you support Production Engineers, collaborating with data engineers, first line support and factory stakeholders to align cross-functional data streams. 
 Functie 
The Factory Engineering department sets the pace for industrialisation and continuous improvement. The production engineering teams are currently operating in an environment undergoing a full-scale ERP migration to SAP, which introduces complex challenges around data mapping, data quality and legacy system integration. 
The goal of the team is to enable engineering and factory strategies by transforming raw transactional data into clean, actionable business intelligence, and to deliver high-end dashboarding and reporting solutions that support Production Engineers in improving cycle time, quality and cost.
